# Polariod Studio

Independent instant photography editorial website; not affiliated with Polaroid.
- [Tutorials](https://polariod-studio.vercel.app/learn/): introductory guides with source links where applicable.
  - [拍下第一张宝丽来](https://polariod-studio.vercel.app/learn/first-frame/)
  - [显影时，为什么要避光？](https://polariod-studio.vercel.app/learn/protect-from-light/)
  - [给每张照片留下一份笔记](https://polariod-studio.vercel.app/learn/photo-notes/)
- [Creators](https://polariod-studio.vercel.app/creators/): only owner-approved creators.
- [Gallery](https://polariod-studio.vercel.app/gallery/): clearly labelled original illustrative placeholders until approved photos are available.

- [Agent reader](https://polariod-studio.vercel.app/agent/) — site structure, source links and limits.
- [Structured catalog](https://polariod-studio.vercel.app/agent/site.json) — same public reader data in JSON.

- [Community reading list](https://polariod-studio.vercel.app/notes/): public note titles, authors, topics, source links and reading status.
- [Content permissions](https://polariod-studio.vercel.app/permissions/): non-commercial personal learning, no republication license granted, original rights retained.
